description: The FEMA National Flood Hazard Layer zone at a US street address, read at the address point: zone, whether it is a Special Flood Hazard Area, zone subtype, floodway and base flood elevation where FEMA returns them, with the query URL and read date. Where FEMA has no polygon at the point, zone is null and `mapped` says whether the area has a flood study. Answers in a few seconds; does not compute the Buildability Score.

property.description: The property being researched: a US street address, e.g. "412 Oak St, Austin, TX".

response_format.description: "concise" (default) leaves out factor notes and verbatim code quotes; every number keeps its source and read date. "detailed" returns them.

name: flood_zone

mapped.description: FEMA has a flood study covering the point; null when the probe did not answer.

record.description: The FEMA query that produced the answer.

sfha.description: Inside a Special Flood Hazard Area at the point; null when no polygon.

zone.description: FEMA zone at the address point; null when FEMA has no polygon there (not Zone X).

title: FEMA flood zone at an address
